protocol: One referred flight engineer with recurrent right-knee pain. One sham run at 12,000 ft actual pressure altitude and two subsequent diagnostic chamber runs to 40,000 ft with knee-bend exercise. The two actual runs used different prebreathe durations.
outcome_window: Observed during the diagnostic runs through symptom resolution on descent. Later clinical follow-up is unreported.
note: The source classified the provoked right-knee pain as bends. The count represents one reported individual. The report supplies no linked clinical cohort denominator.

protocol: Each participant made two matched chamber runs and one actual B-24 flight. The subject protocols used oxygen from 15,000 ft and prescribed step-up exercise from 25,000 ft.
outcome_window: During the 35,000-ft B-24 flight, up to 75 minutes at altitude or earlier termination.
note: Of the 18 who passed both chamber runs, 16 passed and 2 failed their aircraft flight. This stratum partitions the existing 17/36 actual-subject-flights margin with the two other chamber classifications.
